interpretation: COUNT BY SOURCE ROW (139 historical union IDs), not verified item count for any one Last Island version. 'Must transform' counts item-specific Bible differences only, not universal save/target/map integration; 'no delta identified' does not certify unchanged. Existing SOH Core recipes spending Parts are proposals, not Bible-required deltas.

delta_ids.why: Bible K4: random/directed/specimen routes share one run-local recipe authority, and reset at SOH 336-hour run boundary.
Bible K6: SOH Territory Cabinet = claim entity; placed on built foundation, PvE-only territory, physically funded upkeep, resets each run.
Bible K6: authentic power circuits retained, but SOH requires player-safe manual emergency exit and no unavoidable POI softlock.
Bible K7: transport runs with SOH Veyra terrain, cargo/weight, route, fuel, durability, ownership and reset; preserve LI cost before tuning.
Bible K4/K6/K8: actual connected loads, fuel, outage and deterministic offline chronology; preserve LI cost and fuel specs where verified.
Bible K3/K4: genuine sourced oil, fuel/station supply, processing and deterministic offline queue; original LI oil chain baseline retained.

soh_optional_garden_machine: Bible K4 [CHỐT]: optional player-built powered/physical agricultural automation; currently represented by deploy_farm_controller (included among 24 runtime packs); functional object mandatory, exact ID not fixed.
